Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings forming a 'target board' pattern on older foliage, followed by chlorosis.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2 g/L at the first appearance of symptoms. Repeat at 10-14 day intervals.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Spray Neem oil (5ml/L) with soap solution, or apply Copper Hydroxide / Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (5g/L).
Tomato___Early_blight.preventative_measures: Practice crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops, maintain drip irrigation to keep foliage dry, and prune lower leaves.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Irregular water-soaked greasy lesions turning dark brown to purplish with pale borders and white fuzzy sporulation on underside.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray with Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil MZ) @ 2 g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray or copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 3 g/L.
Tomato___Late_blight.preventative_measures: Avoid overhead watering; remove and destroy infected vines immediately; ensure adequate field drainage.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Dark lesion margins on leaf tips and margins; rapid wilting and necrosis during cool, humid weather.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Fenamidone + Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Preventative spraying of fermented cow urine extract or copper sulfate lime wash.
Potato___Late_blight.preventative_measures: Use certified disease-free seed tubers, hill up soil well to protect tubers, and de-haulm before harvest.

Corn___Common_rust.symptoms: Golden brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
Corn___Common_rust.organic_treatment: Sulphur 80% WP dusting @ 2-3 g/L of water.
Corn___Common_rust.preventative_measures: Plant resistant hybrids; plant early in the season to evade maximum spore dispersal periods.

Rice___Bacterial_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked to yellowish stripes along leaf margins with wavy edges; milky bacterial ooze under humid conditions.
Rice___Bacterial_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L mixed with Copper Oxychloride @ 1.5 g/L.
Rice___Bacterial_blight.organic_treatment: Spray fresh cow dung water extract (20%) or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L.
Rice___Bacterial_blight.preventative_measures: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilization; maintain proper water drainage in paddy fields; use tolerant cultivars.

Healthy_Plant.symptoms: Vigorous green foliage with no visible chlorotic lesions, necrotic spots, or fungal mycelia.
Healthy_Plant.organic_treatment: Maintain balanced organic manure, vermicompost, and regular microbial bio-fertilizers.
Healthy_Plant.preventative_measures: Regular monitoring and balanced N-P-K nutrient management.
